picks.name: HAAi
picks.source_note: Already in your library (previously seeded via the "Ignition" preview single in August) -- this is the full album that single was previewing, a different, newer release. Exact Bandcamp album-page slug unconfirmable via search, so the purchase link points to her confirmed-live Bandcamp root (pre-orders were confirmed offered via Bandcamp alongside Mute's own store).
picks.bio: "DIGITiSE" (October 9, 2026, Mute) is HAAi's third album, a dancefloor-focused companion to 2025's HUMANiSE -- ten tracks featuring Pat Alvarez, Echonomist, Kaiden Ford, ILA, James Massiah, and Medellín children's choir Cantoalegre.
picks.why_listen: Built specifically for the arc of a DJ set -- high-energy, broken-beat-leaning club tracks that pull her more contemplative HUMANiSE material toward the dancefloor.
